messages:
eli: FYI bringing up HF->Redwood for gpt-small-ish and seeing token count diffs on inputs with combining marks and weird leading-space behavior. e.g. 'cafe\u0301' vs 'café' tokenize into different counts which shifts prompt windows.
maya: Yup, saw that during quant experiments. Our HF->Redwood converter normalizes to NFKC by default which can collapse some compatibility marks. Also the converter's byte-fallback policy differs from HF's 'replace' vs 'byte' option.
sam: The bad bit: quantized int8 model manifests a 1-2 token shift for messages with combining accents, which pushed assistant responses over the max length and we got truncated completions -> quality regression on convo evals.
priya: Quick repro I used:
```
# convert with explicit normalization + preserve byte fallback
python -m rwd.tokenizer_convert --hf-dir ./hf_model --out ./redwood_tok --norm NFC --preserve-byte-fallback
```
That restored token counts to match HF for my test set.
eli: Also watch chat templates. HF chat-conversion assumes some tokenizers add a leading space for assistant messages (the old 'Ġ' / prefix-space thing). Our template strip led to off-by-one tokens in prompt assembly.
maya: Suggested change: add a flag in converter "--preserve-pretokenization" that leaves HF pre-tokenization steps intact, and expose normalization choice in model config JSON as "tokenizer_normalization": "NFC|NFKC|NFD" so ops can opt out.
sam: I'll open a small PR with tests. Plan: add unit for combining marks + a short eval comparing token counts across 10k sample prompts and run our chat-eval harness.
priya: Also note: some HF tokenizers use byte-fallback for unknowns which increases token count but avoids replacement U+FFFD. If we switch to replacement, prompts collapse. Need to keep parity.
deploy-bot: converter v2.1 deployed to staging for ENG-ML, rollout 10% (sha: a1b2c3), see https://staging.redwood/internal/deploys/conv-v2.1
maya: After PR we should run quantized A/B on our regression suite (long prompts, combining marks, emojis). If metrics change >1.5% on QA score revert.
eli: Great. @sam please link the PR here and ping when staging converter includes --preserve-pretokenization. :thumbsup:
